LanguageData.CC_MadeForWear_Held: The {PIECE} made for {PAWN_nameDef} is ready. {PAWN_nameDef} will put it on when back near the base.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_MadeForWearLater: Clothes made for someone, put on when they are back
LanguageData.CC_Settings_MadeForWearLater_Tip: Nice Inventory Tab lets you order a piece of clothing or armour for a colonist from their gear tab, and once it is made it sends them to put it on at once, even from the far side of the map. With this on, a colonist who is away keeps working: the piece goes to storage, a message says it is ready, and they put it on the next time they pick a job while back in the home area near it. Someone already nearby goes at once, as before. Off, the mod's own way.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_MadeForWearLater: A colonist away puts their new piece on when back near the base.
